notes: Green: two tiers joined by a steep ridge (sources: an upper back section falling hard to the front, high on the right). The upper back-right tier (E 536688-536700, N 4291165-4291181, dem_raw 304.4-304.7 m) is about 1 m above the main surface (303.1-303.8 m); the ridge between them (15-20 %) is what puts the green's slope p95 at about 14.3 %, not a bank. The SE tail round the back of the left bunker (a 10 % fall-off) is removed in QA round 2; the green collar (two fringe features) carried hole 14 and is reassigned to 3. Bunkers: four, as the golfcourse.wiki diagram (two left, one right, one short), all on sand and LiDAR hollows.
